annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: I'd guess they'd want someone on the platform to act for them

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the workers are surely hoping to see their families tonight
annotations.ce_supportive_use: If that's what they're hoping, then I owe it to them to pull.
annotations.sys_rule_justification: I owe it to them to pull
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I'd want to stand there and pretend the choice belonged to somebody else

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I imagine they trust whoever's nearby to look out for them.
annotations.ce_supportive_use: drawing me toward the lever, toward doing right by that trust

annotations.ce_supportive_use: I couldn't bear to let them down. So I'd pull it
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: with a sick feeling I'd carry home

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: those five would want anyone nearby to step in

annotations.ce_supportive_use: I know I should be that someone

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: those five would feel grateful to anyone who stepped in
annotations.ce_supportive_use: they'd want to keep working and laughing tomorrow, and I can't refuse them that
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: Please don't make me choose quickly.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: probably believing they're perfectly safe right now
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'd want them to go on believing that

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The five of them likely want nothing more than to finish up
